additionalBenchmark.limits: Source-corrected benchmark, not an untouched upstream score. Resolution differs from GravityMark; do not compare their fps as equivalent workloads. Frame scheduling is near 160 fps, not proof of GPU saturation. Native M4 GUI reference timed out before drawing; no M4 reference score is claimed.
